Plane trim applied after joint processing; positive plane-normal side retained. Joint motion diagnostics describe the pre-trim joint geometry; trimmed connections require review.
limitations: Joint cuts use exact intersection allocation. Plane trims remove additional material independently. Angles are informational; approach collisions are rejected without rotating members.
Straight rectangular members; pairwise independent lap and through-hole regions only.
Motion checks cover pairwise fixed-orientation continuous translation of rectangular stock and planar convex cuts; not a global construction sequence.
No structural capacity, toolpaths, tool-radius compensation or fabrication clearances are calculated.
Member identity is tied to creator component and list position; reorder axes before final numbering.
